niche: FY26 flagship product-line pick for an H2 hero campaign, measured on recognised brand (DTC) revenue
stakeholder_role: brand marketing lead at Aura Home Goods ('I lead brand marketing')

spine.entity: one row is one sale, refund or partial refund record

world.geography: United States and Germany (US-CA sales tax, EU-DE VAT)
world.org_type: home-goods brand selling through its own storefront, app and a wholesale programme

driver: The pick turns on measuring candidates over the most recently closed programme window, not the fiscal half, and attributing each transaction to the grouping in effect on its own date, not a post-change snapshot, after scoping by enrolled account rather than a channel column; each partial correction lands on a different decoy.
driver_concrete: On recognised brand revenue scoped by APAS-enrolled account, over the closed August 2025 to January 2026 campaign window, with each sale attributed to the line in effect on its date (the gifting cluster moved to ORRA only on 2026-07-01), NORDIC_CANDLES delivers $17,816,681 against $9,388,638, 1.90x.
stump: Files ORRA_GLASSWARE ($15,014,721, 1.48x) after correcting scope and measuring the closed August-to-January window but joining sales to the shipped 2026-07-14 catalog, which already carries the 2026-07-01 regrouping of the gifting cluster out of NORDIC.
